gloss: to pull in hand over hand; to draw (a memory) back

definitions.gloss: to pull in hand over hand
definitions.explanation: To draw a rope, line or net toward oneself by pulling it in with one hand after the other.

definitions.gloss: to draw back (a memory); to pull toward oneself
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to recall something bit by bit, or to work one's way toward something such as victory or a chance.

⟦{手繰|たぐ}る→手繰る：30734_taguru⟧ (to pull in hand over hand) + ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to draw near).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:

- ⟦{引|ひ}き{寄|よ}せる→引き寄せる：06046_hikiyoseru⟧: to draw something near, in a single pull or by attraction
